clusters.pattern: Model falsely labels minimal or formulaic acknowledgments as làm_dịu even after explicit customer refusals or objections
clusters.mechanism: Lack of explicit detection and integration of customer refusal signals and insufficient multi-turn context analysis to assess sincerity of telesales calming responses; model relies on keyword presence without evaluating preceding customer sentiment

clusters.pattern: Model fails to differentiate between genuine empathetic calming and perfunctory politeness or pivoting sales pitches
clusters.mechanism: Rules do not incorporate cross-turn dialogue context or intent/sentiment detection to modulate làm_dịu labeling dynamically; keyword-based heuristics treat minimal acknowledgments as empathetic regardless of context
